channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: OpenSSH 10.6p2 has been released with a workaround for a critical vulnerability
Baidu released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base
item.description: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base: a 280B-A14B hybrid-attention MoE pretrained on 33.5T tokens. An open, efficient pretraining base. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Amazon Cognito announces 99.99% Service Level Agreement for the Plus feature plan
item.description: Starting November 1, 2026, the Amazon Cognito Service Level Agreement (SLA) commits to a Monthly Uptime Percentage of 99.99% for user pools on the Plus feature plan, up from 99.9%. (1 source: aws)

item.title: IAM Roles Anywhere now supports automatic certificate revocation checking
item.description: AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) Roles Anywhere now supports automatic revocation checking using certificate revocation list (CRL) distribution points (CDPs). (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SageMaker AI Studio Now Supports IAM Identity Center Multi-Region Replication
item.description: Amazon SageMaker AI now supports IAM Identity Center (IdC) multi-region replication, enabling you to deploy SageMaker AI Studio domains in different regions from your IdC instance's primary region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon MWAA now supports cost allocation tags
item.description: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) now supports cost allocation tags . Tags you apply to an Amazon MWAA environment now propagate to the compute that runs it, including workers, schedulers, and web servers. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon ECS Managed Daemons can now collect json-file logs from application containers on Amazon ECS Managed Instances
item.description: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) introduces json-file log driver support for Amazon ECS Managed Instances and log driver volumes for Amazon ECS Managed Daemons. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) is now available in the Asia Pacific (Taipei) and Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Regions
item.description: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) is now available in the Asia Pacific (Taipei) and Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Regions, adding to the list of available Regions where you can use Amazon DocumentDB. (1 source: aws)
